additional_info.subject: ID0470969-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / S6 170003777] Plug 1 is in error CRM:03056000897
additional_info.body:
Hello Gerrit, good afternoon. Happy New Year, I hope you are doing well.
I checked remotely and the Plug1 seems to be reading the temperature values incorrectly:
It's reading 0 ohm for both temperature sensors.
Please check on site these connections on green, pink and orange:
You can start from the green measurement:
if you don't see ~1kOhm
Replace the cable.
If you see ~1kOhm, then please continue measuring until the KF14 screws where the cables are attached.
If you see 1kOhm on the KF14
Please try to replace the grey connector with a spare one from an adjacent EcoG component that is not being used.
If it still persists, replace KF14
If you don't see 1kOhm on the KF14, it must be dropped between the green measurement and KF14.
Please let me know if you have any doubts or questions.
Thanks and have a nice weekend.
Best regards,
Francisco
